$Comment: Bram's secret: every Christmas Present a player opens rolls once more, for one of the game's Christmas
decorations or the snowflake tree topper (the table Christmas_Bram_Decorations), once that player holds
either key to it: Bram's apprentice quest, or Woodcutting level 20 on a server running MMO Skill Tree
ContributesTo folds this roll into the present's own table (Christmas_Present_Gift) without touching its
file. Requires here is no mod gate: its condition, Christmas_Bram_Key with Min 1, is asked of the player
who opens the present each time one is opened, in front of this file's roll, so a player without a key
rolls the present exactly as its own file says. A present given to a friend pays its own table
(Christmas_Present_Given), not this one. HideInPreview keeps the roll off the present's hover, which
lists the same contents for everyone.
Name: Christmas_Bram_Present
